node.label: Quad & Indo-Pacific
node.summary: The India-US-Japan-Australia Quad and Indo-Pacific cooperation.

facts.text: Quad = **India, US, Japan, Australia**. It grew from the **2004 tsunami** response core group, was revived in **2017** and held its first leaders' summit in **2021**. The US holds the **G20 presidency in 2026**.
facts.plain: Quad = India, US, Japan, Australia. It grew from the 2004 tsunami response core group, was revived in 2017 and held its first leaders' summit in 2021. The US holds the G20 presidency in 2026.

facts.text: **Quad Foreign Ministers** (Rubio, **S. Jaishankar**, Japan's **Toshimitsu Motegi**, Australia's **Penny Wong**) met in **Atlanta** on the sidelines of the **G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting**: **$85 million** in technical aid for trusted AI across the Indo-Pacific; the US pledged **$10 million** for critical-minerals recycling in India and ASEAN.
